newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish trader Minex seeks listing within two years.
newsitem.headline: Polish trader Minex seeks listing within two years.

text.p: Polish trader Minex SA, which imports and exports glass, ceramics and building materials, seeks a listing on the main market of the Warsaw bourse within two years, the company's spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"We would like to enter the bourse in the course of two years, on the main market," Marzena Malinowska told Reuters.
The state treasury currently holds 54 percent of Minex's 403,900 shares, followed by Irena with nine percent, Gorazdze with seven percent and Krosno six percent.
The firm made a net profit of 1.2 million zlotys last year on sales of 69 million zlotys.
